title: Cinnamon Crispies
description: Spicy, sugar-free biscuits made from ripe bananas, ground cinnamon and desiccated coconut. Best eaten warm, straight out of the oven.
steps: Gently mash the bananas in a bowl with a fork, then put them in a food processor along with the cinnamon. Blitz for 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add half the coconut, blitz, then add the rest. Continue to mix until fully blended. The dough should be stiff but still moist.
Use a pair of teaspoons to drop small blobs of the dough on to a baking sheet lined with greaseproof paper, around 2cm apart. Press down with a fork making a criss-cross pattern.
Bake for 20–25 minutes until golden brown, rotating the tray halfway through.
notes: Makes around 16 crispies. Per crispie estimate.
